title: Marlowe Rewards Birthday Shopping Boost
content:
A Marlowe Rewards member who has shopped in the month leading up to the claim of their birthday bonus receives a birthday shopping boost on it.

## The boost

The boost is decided by the merchandise booked on the member's orders placed within the month ending on the claim date. An order dated on the same day of the previous month does not count. The tier amount is the birthday points of the tier held on the claim date.

| Merchandise booked in that month | Effect on the tier amount |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | The tier amount is doubled (multiplied by 2) |
| above 0 but under 150.00 | That merchandise is credited again as birthday points and added to the tier amount. The rate is the base points per USD multiplied by the points multiplier of the tier held on the claim date, rounded to the nearest whole point with a half point rounding up |
| nothing booked | The tier amount stands |

Where the tier held carries no birthday points, no birthday bonus is posted and the boost gives nothing.

## Worked cases (hypothetical tier amount of 350 points, base rate of 1, tier multiplier of 1.50)

| Merchandise booked in the month | Boosted amount |
|---|---|
| 180.00 | 700 |
| 150.00 | 700 |
| 149.99 | 350 plus 225 (224.985 rounded), which is 575 |
| 92.40 | 350 plus 139 (138.6 rounded), which is 489 |
| none | 350 |

## The month (hypothetical claim date of 18 June 2025)

Orders dated 19 May 2025 through 18 June 2025 count. An order dated 18 May 2025 does not.
